title: Messages | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Messages
hero.lead: Read, reply to and send internal Kaderblick messages here. Open the user menu in the top-right corner and select Messages. Its number shows unread messages.

body:
Inbox and sent messages

  • Inbox contains received messages; its number is the unread count.
  • Sent shows your outgoing messages.
  • The search field filters the current list; X clears the search.
  • Mark all as read changes every unread inbox item.
  • The two icons on the right switch between chronological list and conversations. Conversations group replies into a thread; arrows collapse or expand them.
  • Load more appears at the end when further messages exist.

Read and manage a message

  1. Select a message on the left. Opening marks it as read.
  2. The detail header shows subject, sender, time and recipient or recipient context.
  3. Available actions appear below the text.
  • Reply addresses the sender and quotes the previous message.
  • Reply all appears for several recipients.
  • Forward copies subject and content; you choose new recipients.
  • Mark as unread resets a received message.
  • Send again is available under Sent.
  • Delete opens a confirmation containing the subject. Only Delete permanently removes it from your folder.

Write a new message

  1. Select New message.
  2. Search for individual people under To and add them. Context after a name helps choose correctly.
  3. If needed, add recipients through + Group, + Team or + Club. Available collective targets depend on your assignments.
  4. Enter a subject and message.
  5. Select Send. Afterwards, write another message or switch to Sent.

Discard clears the draft and returns to the previous view. Leaving a draft that already contains a subject, text or collective target requires confirmation.

Send to a team or club

After + Team or + Club, choose the target. For each one, select the offered recipient groups. Remove a target with its row’s remove icon. This lets you address only the intended groups within that team.

Use and manage recipient groups

  1. Select + Group while composing.
  2. Choose a saved group. X removes its row from the draft.
  3. Open Manage groups to change saved groups.

Under New group, enter a group name and choose members. Save creates it. Existing groups can be edited or deleted; deletion requires confirmation.

Using messages on a phone

On small screens, the window shows either list, message or draft. Back returns from a message to the list. Reply, forward, unread and delete actions use icons with accessible labels.

Connection to notifications

An unread message increases the message counter. Opening it from a matching notification takes you directly to the message and updates its read status.
